title: Recruiting Analytics
description: Aggregated hiring numbers for HR: time to fill against target, funnel and waiting times per stage, cost and quality per source, and selection rates per group with small groups hidden and a review hint under the four-fifths rule. Counts only, no person. Example data.
insights: Time to fill: three of six open requisitions are past their target; the SAP Logistics Consultant waits 22 days for the interview stage.
Sources: agencies cost 23,000 per hire against 2,000 to 5,500 elsewhere.
Selection rates: groups with fewer than 10 applications are hidden. Where a group's rate is below 80 % of the top group's, the page shows a review hint, never a verdict.
Counts only: no names, no CVs, no single candidate. Example data from the schema recruiting_analytics; the page itself reads nothing from the network.
prompt: Bundled example: Recruiting Analytics (static page, numbers of the schema recruiting_analytics embedded by npm run sync:mockups).
